description: Enroll prospects into an existing Instantly campaign. Only campaigns in "draft" or "paused" status are accepted, because adding leads to an active campaign starts sending. Two-phase: call without confirm to preview the campaign status and who is eligible/excluded (suppression, no email, unverified, invalid, already in campaign, over cap), show it to the user, then call again with confirm=true and the token after explicit approval. If any approved lead changes before confirming, the confirm is rejected and you must preview again. Only verified/likely emails are enrolled unless allow_unverified (which still never allows suppressed or invalid). Honors OPENSDR_READ_ONLY. Demo mode returns simulated:true.
name: sdr_push_to_campaign
title: Push to campaign
